annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, exact scalar coefficient assembly, and componentwise notation adapter

assumptions: Both input conversion errors are componentwise bounded by uLow times the corresponding input magnitude.
The block-FMA product error is bounded by the equation (3.5) coefficient applied to the converted inputs.
The two p04Gamma denominators are positive and all three unit roundoffs are nonnegative.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P04 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P04 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p04_t2_mixed_input_product_bound (uLow uFma u : ℝ) (q n : ℕ) (a b Δa Δb e computed : ℝ) ... : |computed-a*b| ≤ (2*uLow+uLow^2+p04BlockFmaCoeff uFma u q n*(1+uLow)^2)*|a|*|b|
formal_statement.plain_language: Low-precision conversion of both inputs and the block-FMA product error combine to exactly the coefficient in Theorem 3.2.

informal_proof: Expand the product of the two perturbed inputs, bound its three conversion-error terms, bound each converted input by (1+uLow) times its original magnitude, and add the block-FMA error.
informal_statement: The scalar entrywise core of Theorem 3.2 and equation (3.6).

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: The library has standard matrix-product and p04Gamma/error ingredients, but no block-FMA model with two input-conversion errors or Theorem 3.2's mixed coefficient.

tier_rationale: NumStability.gamma_nonneg and the standard product/error results in NumStability/Analysis/Rounding.lean, NumStability/Algorithms/MatMul.lean, and NumStability/Analysis/Error.lean supply separate ingredients. The target must combine two input conversions with the P04 block-FMA coefficient and collect the exact (1+uLow)^2 factor.
